vsm1.7:43.1:
Dveasīti sahassāni, ajjhogāḷho mahaṇṇave;
Accuggato tāvadeva, cakkavāḷasiluccayo;
vsm1.7:43.8:
Pāṭalī simbalī jambū, devānaṃ pāricchattako;
Kadambo kapparukkho ca, sirīsena bhavati sattamanti.
vsm1.7:44.9: Taṃ sabbampi ekaṃ cakkavāḷaṃ ekā lokadhātu.
vsm1.7:44.12: bhagavā anantena buddhañāṇena avedi aññāsi paṭivijjhi.
vsm1.7:46.1: Attanā pana guṇehi visiṭṭhatarassa kassaci abhāvato
vsm1.7:46.8: Yathāha – ‘‘na kho panāhaṃ samanupassāmi sadevake loke samārake…pe…
vsm1.7:46.12: ‘‘na me ācariyo atthī’’tiādikā (ma. ni. 1.285; mahāva. 11) gāthāyo ca vitthāretabbā.
vsm1.7:47.3: Tattha purisadammāti adantā dametuṃ yuttā tiracchānapurisāpi manussapurisāpi amanussapurisāpi.
vsm1.7:47.4: Tathā hi bhagavatā tiracchānapurisāpi apalālo nāgarājā, cūḷodaro, mahodaro,
vsm1.7:47.5: aggisikho, dhūmasikho, aravāḷo nāgarājā, dhanapālako hatthīti evamādayo
vsm1.7:47.6: damitā nibbisā katā saraṇesu ca sīlesu ca patiṭṭhāpitā,
vsm1.7:47.10: ‘‘Ahaṃ kho, kesi, purisadamme saṇhenapi vinemi, pharusenapi vinemi, saṇhapharusenapi vinemī’’ti (a. ni. 4.11) idañcettha suttaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm1.7:48.1: Apica bhagavā visuddhasīlādīnaṃ paṭhamajjhānādīni sotāpannādīnañca uttari maggapaṭipadaṃ ācikkhanto dantepi dametiyeva.
vsm1.7:48.2: Atha vā anuttaro purisadammasārathīti ekamevidaṃ atthapadaṃ.
vsm1.7:48.4: yathā ekapallaṅkeneva nisinnā aṭṭha disā asajjamānā dhāvanti.
vsm1.7:48.6: ‘‘Hatthidamakena, bhikkhave, hatthidammo sārito ekaṃyeva disaṃ dhāvatī’’ti idañcettha suttaṃ (ma. ni. 3.312) vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm1.7:49.2: Apica satthā viyāti satthā, bhagavā satthavāho.
vsm1.7:49.3: Yathā satthavāho satthe kantāraṃ tāreti corakantāraṃ tāreti
vsm1.7:49.4: vāḷakantāraṃ tāreti dubbhikkhakantāraṃ tāreti nirudakakantāraṃ tāreti
vsm1.7:49.6: evameva bhagavā satthā satthavāho satte kantāraṃ tāreti, jātikantāraṃ tāretītiādinā niddesanayenapettha attho veditabbo.
vsm1.7:50.4: Tepi hi bhagavato dhammassavanena upanissayasampattiṃ patvā
vsm1.7:50.5: tāya eva upanissayasampattiyā dutiye vā tatiye vā attabhāve maggaphalabhāgino honti.
vsm1.7:51.2: Bhagavati kira gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre campānagaravāsīnaṃ dhammaṃ desiyamāne
vsm1.7:51.3: eko maṇḍūko bhagavato sare nimittaṃ aggahesi,
vsm1.7:51.4: taṃ eko vacchapālako daṇḍaṃ olubbha tiṭṭhanto sīse sannirumbhitvā aṭṭhāsi.
vsm1.7:51.5: So tāvadeva kālaṅkatvā tāvatiṃsabhavane dvādasayojanike kanakavimāne nibbatti.
vsm1.7:51.6: Suttappabuddho viya ca tattha accharāsaṅghaparivutaṃ attānaṃ disvā
vsm1.7:51.7: ‘‘are ahampi nāma idha nibbatto, kiṃ nu kho kammamakāsi’’nti āvajjento
vsm1.7:51.8: na aññaṃ kiñci addasa aññatra bhagavato sare nimittaggāhā.
vsm1.7:51.9: So tāvadeva saha vimānena āgantvā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandi.
vsm1.7:51.11:
‘‘Ko me vandati pādāni, iddhiyā yasasā jalaṃ;
Abhikkantena vaṇṇena, sabbā obhāsayaṃ disā’’ti.
vsm1.7:51.16: Devaputtopi sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāya sitaṃ katvā pakkamīti.
vsm1.7:52.1: Yaṃ pana kiñci atthi ñeyyaṃ nāma, sabbasseva buddhattā vimokkhantikaññāṇavasena buddho.
vsm1.7:52.2: Yasmā vā cattāri saccāni attanāpi bujjhi,
vsm1.7:52.5: Imassa ca panatthassa viññāpanatthaṃ ‘‘bujjhitā saccānīti buddho.
vsm1.7:52.7: evaṃ pavatto sabbopi niddesanayo (mahāni. 192) paṭisambhidānayo (paṭi. ma. 1.162) vā vitthāretabbo.
vsm1.7:53.3:
‘‘Bhagavāti vacanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ, bhagavāti vacanamuttamaṃ;
Garugāravayutto so, bhagavā tena vuccatī’’ti.
vsm1.7:54.3: Adhiccasamuppannaṃ nāma lokiyavohārena yadicchakanti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:54.4: Tattha vaccho dammo balībaddoti evamādi āvatthikaṃ.
vsm1.7:54.5: Daṇḍī chattī sikhī karīti evamādi liṅgikaṃ.
vsm1.7:55.2: na mahāmāyāya, na suddhodanamahārājena, na asītiyā ñātisahassehi kataṃ,
vsm1.7:55.6: vimokkhantikametaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutaññāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ bhagavā’’ti (mahāni. 84).
vsm1.7:56.1: Yaṃguṇanemittikañcetaṃ nāmaṃ, tesaṃ guṇānaṃ pakāsanatthaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ vadanti –
vsm1.7:56.2:
‘‘Bhagī bhajī bhāgi vibhattavā iti,
Akāsi bhagganti garūti bhāgyavā;
Bahūhi ñāyehi subhāvitattano,
Bhavantago so bhagavāti vuccatī’’ti.
vsm1.7:56.3: Niddese (mahāni. 84) vuttanayeneva cettha tesaṃ tesaṃ padānaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo.
vsm1.7:57.2:
Bhāgyavā bhaggavā yutto, bhagehi ca vibhattavā;
Bhattavā vantagamano, bhavesu bhagavā tatoti.
vsm1.7:58.3: yasmā lokiyalokuttarasukhābhinibbattakaṃ dānasīlādipārappattaṃ bhāgyamassa atthi, tasmā bhāgyavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccatīti ñātabbaṃ.
vsm1.7:59.6: saṅkhepato vā pañca kilesakhandhaabhisaṅkhāradevaputtamaccumāre abhañji. Tasmā bhaggattā etesaṃ parissayānaṃ bhaggavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccati.
vsm1.7:59.9: Bhaggāssa pāpakā dhammā, bhagavā tena vuccatī’’ti.
vsm1.7:60.1: Bhāgyavatāya cassa satapuññalakkhaṇadharassa rūpakāyasampatti dīpitā hoti.
vsm1.7:61.2: bhagā assa santīti iminā atthena bhagavāti vuccati.
vsm1.7:61.3: Yasmā ca loke issariyadhammayasasirikāmapayattesu chasu dhammesu bhagasaddo pavattati,
vsm1.7:61.9: Yaṃ yaṃ etena icchitaṃ patthitaṃ attahitaṃ parahitaṃ vā, tassa tassa tatheva abhinipphannattā icchitatthanibbattisaññito kāmo.
vsm1.7:62.7: vibhajitvā vivaritvā desitavāti vuttaṃ hoti. Tasmā vibhattavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccati.
vsm1.7:63.4: aññe ca lokiyalokuttare uttarimanussadhamme bhaji sevi bahulaṃ akāsi, tasmā bhattavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccati.
vsm1.7:64.1: Yasmā pana tīsu bhavesu taṇhāsaṅkhātaṃ gamanaṃ anena vantaṃ, tasmā bhavesu vantagamanoti vattabbe
vsm1.7:64.2: bhavasaddato bhakāraṃ gamanasaddato gakāraṃ vantasaddato vakārañca dīghaṃ katvā ādāya bhagavāti vuccati
vsm1.7:64.3: yathā loke mehanassa khassa mālāti vattabbe mekhalāti.
vsm1.7:65.1: Tassevaṃ iminā ca iminā ca kāraṇena so bhagavā arahaṃ…pe… iminā ca iminā ca kāraṇena bhagavāti buddhaguṇe anussarato
vsm1.7:65.2: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.7:65.3: na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:65.4: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgatamārabbha (a. ni. 6.10).
vsm1.7:66.11: Tadetaṃ buddhaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā buddhānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.7:67.1: Imañca pana buddhānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu satthari sagāravo hoti sappatisso,
vsm1.7:67.11: sammukhā satthāraṃ passato viya hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhāti.
